text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Tore-san. 
I managed to acquire some wonderful tea 
yesterday... 
Would you care to join me for a cup?"
choice_data_list: I'd love to! Where is it from?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It is tea grown along a riverbank 
basking in the sun."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hand-picked, leaf by leaf, and slowly 
dried in the sunlight... 
Hehe, going a little deeper in than usual 
was worth it."
choice_data_list: ...Wait, hold on. You made it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, please enjoy. 
It's my special—wild herbal tea."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact crafted and savored her 
homemade wild herb tea 
out in nature. It seems she spent a 
wonderfully 
fragrant day off!
